purpose: Prove the headless-run usage accounting end to end: candidate rebuilt from best-agent feat/run-usage-accounting f329c2f4 (spec 176) plus a plugin that reads the run's durable thread_metrics row, and a harness/report that surfaces the reported tokens.

predecessorRun.note: Same candidate and task; the Pier trial's agent_result already carried the usage (n_input_tokens 161419 / n_cache_tokens 142080 / n_output_tokens 7449, 13 model calls), but the frozen per-task record and report dropped it, which is what run 35443189922 fixes.

candidate.note: Source commit is best-agent PR #74 (spec 176). The SEA binary is still not byte-reproducible: this run's sha256 differs from run 35442528442's 899075e8f56a… for the same source commit.

terminal-bench/vulnerable-secret.note: Pier's trial result.json agent_result carries n_input_tokens/n_output_tokens/n_cache_tokens plus metadata.usage (model_call_count, reported_call_count, reported_input_tokens), written by the plugin from <logs_dir>/best-agent-runtime/v3-threads.sqlite; the harness now projects the same block into the frozen per-task record and the report sums it.
